description: Use to price a choice before booking or ordering, or when an owner asks what they would charge for a job: pass their own business id. Use item ids, option group ids and choice ids from catalog. options is {group_id: [choice_id, …]}; fields answer the item's questions. fulfillment: appointment, reservation, pickup, delivery, onsite or request (default: the first all items share). Returns itemized lines and the estimate (delivery includes its fee). Review it with the customer before booking or ordering.
name: quote
title: Price a selection
